Forged.tagline: Heavy, simple and repeatable. Three full-body days, each led by a big barbell lift.
Forged.forWho: Men who want to get stronger on the big lifts and are willing to be patient with the weight on the bar.
youGet: Three full-body lifting days a week, led by the squat, deadlift and bench press, with six exercises each
Two easy recovery days (an incline walk or stair climb plus mobility) so you can train hard on lifting days
Main sets held 1 to 2 reps short of failure, with 2 to 3 minutes of rest
Lift variations that rotate through the year, such as pause squat, trap bar deadlift and pause bench
An optional fourth full-body volume day
A lighter deload week at the end of every four-week block
Forged.intensity: Moderate to hard. Most work sets end with 1 to 2 good reps still in the tank.

Built.tagline: Three full-body days with controlled volume, built for muscle size.
Built.forWho: Men who want more muscle and a thicker, stronger build, and who like steady progress through reps and load.
youGet: Three full-body lifting days led by the bench press, overhead press and incline bench, with six exercises each
Rep ranges with a simple rule: add load once you hit the top of the range on every set
Controlled lowering and 60 to 90 seconds of rest between sets
Sets that stop 1 to 3 reps short of failure
Two easy recovery days (an incline walk or stair climb plus mobility) between lifting days
An optional fourth full-body pump day
A lighter deload week at the end of every four-week block
Built.intensity: Moderate to hard. Sets stop 1 to 3 reps short of failure, so you finish working but not wrecked.

Engine.tagline: Build your gas tank with intervals, circuits and steady aerobic work.
Engine.forWho: Men who want better stamina and work capacity, for sport, for work, or just to keep up with life.
youGet: Three hard sessions a week: intervals, a strength circuit and a metabolic complex
An aerobic base day at a conversational pace, plus an active recovery day
Interval and circuit work that swaps to match the equipment you have
Sessions of about 45 minutes
An optional fourth day of loaded carries
A lighter deload week at the end of every four-week block
Engine.intensity: Hard days run at about 8 out of 10 effort. Easy days stay at a pace where you can speak in full sentences.

Warrior.tagline: Power, mobility and combat conditioning for an athletic build.
Warrior.forWho: Men who want to move, carry and strike like an athlete: explosive, mobile and conditioned.
youGet: Two full-body power-and-strength days that pair jumps, swings and plyometrics with heavy lifts
A combat circuit day
A mobility and movement day (with Turkish get-ups) and an active recovery day
An optional fourth day of combat conditioning with shadow boxing rounds
Fast, crisp reps: stop a power set when your speed drops
A lighter deload week at the end of every four-week block
Warrior.intensity: Moderate to hard. Power sets are done fast with full rest, and strength sets stay 1 to 3 good reps short of failure.
